t: You humiliated me in front of half the school, Potter. That mistaken identity bit was cruel and calculated.
Filch is wheezing toward us through the archway right now. We argue later if we still can.
Somebody is out of bed again tonight, and I will find every last one of you before the professors do.
B Parkinson wrote this note, so Pansy is the one holding something over you. That explains why you vanished from the ball early.
Hand it back this instant, Potter, or I will make you regret reading a single word. My business with Pansy is mine alone.
Parkinson, you would not recognise loyalty if it bit you. That parchment belongs to me and you will return it before anyone else sees a single line.
Father's owl reaches Lucius before dawn unless you hand over the Slytherin prefect badge tomorrow. Consider it insurance for my silence.
This tunnel connects straight to the seventh floor corridor if the map is accurate. We can bypass Filch entirely and reach the tower before midnight.
You expect me to crawl through filth because you kicked a grate open? My robes are ruined and Pansy holds my father's wrath in an envelope.

I found these Polyjuice components in Pansy's trunk three nights ago and tracked every missing ingredient since. She stole them to brew a disguise while making you the perfect distraction for her own escape.
She played me from the start, using my desperation to cover her theft while I scrambled to protect my father's name. We have been chasing the same snake in different directions this entire time.
Open this door immediately, Potter. I will not tolerate students vanishing from a supervised event while a caretaker chases shadows.
I slipped away for air, Professor. No one else is here and the cloak never left my trunk.
This vial is evidence, Professor. The actual thief remains inside the Room of Requirement brewing Polyjuice right now. I found the bottle near the tapestry while Filch chased us down the hallway.
You expect me to believe a student stumbled onto a serious breach while violating curfew? You have earned detention every Saturday until June. We will discuss your sources at length then.
The ink moves without a wand, forming words I did not write. The message reads Polyjuice batch ready midnight Astronomy Tower signed with a single initial.
Pansy's threat bought me hours, but this note buys me a target. I will be in that tower before the clock strikes twelve.
